WELCOME TO KUBU LODGES
YOUR GATEWAY TO A WILDLIFE OASIS
Nestled conveniently near Hoedspruit, Kubu Lodges serves as the perfect hub for venturing into the neighbouring region often referred to as the gateway to a wildlife oasis. Kubu Lodges consists of two distinguished 4-star accommodations Kubu Safari Lodge and the smaller more intimate Kubu Bush Lodge. Each lodge presents an alluring dinner, bed, and breakfast package, delivering an affordable and immersive experience for guests. Furthermore, we provide an extensive array of activities, encompassing guided safaris conducted in our open safari vehicles into the Kruger National Park as well as guided walking safaris on-site. Beyond that, guests can partake in a selection of other thrilling activities in the area, ensuring a diverse and unforgettable experience during their stay.
Kubu Safari Lodge
Embark on an exhilarating journey at Kubu Safari Lodge, sprawled across twenty-five hectares of pristine natural bush and graced by over a kilometer of captivating Klaserie River frontage. When you re not out adventuring, plunge into our refreshing pool—a perfect escape from the pulsating African heat.
Get ready for a culinary adventure as our talented chefs craft an authentic taste of Africa. Whether it s the lively atmosphere of our boma, the comfort of our indoor dining, or the scenic beauty of our riverside deck for special occasions, every meal becomes a thrilling experience.
At Kubu Safari Lodge, excitement awaits at every turn—nature, flavour, and unforgettable moments.
Click Here to find out more
KUBU BUSH LODGE
Nestled adjacent to Kubu Safari Lodge, Kubu Bush Lodge offers an intimate retreat for those in search of tranquillity. This cozy lodge features a stunning waterhole that attracts a diverse array of general wildlife. Guests desiring relaxation, can unwind on their private balcony or visit the pool lapa, soaking in the beauty of nature unfolding.
Dining at Kubu Bush Lodge is a delightful adventure, with options to savour meals in our atmospheric boma or outdoors on our inviting deck area.
Immerse yourself in the serenity of Kubu Bush Lodge, where quietude and the wonders of nature converge for an unforgettable experience.
Click Here to find out more
Click Here to view our special
ACTIVITIES ON OFFER
WIDE RANGE OF ACTIVITIES FOR EVERYONE
Embark on a journey of discovery with our guided safaris, where the untamed beauty of Kruger National Park awaits you. Our open safari vehicles provide an immersive experience, allowing you to witness the wonders of the wild up close. In addition to Kruger, we offer safaris in a private Big 5 game reserve, ensuring an exclusive and unforgettable adventure. Beyond the safari, our location is a treasure trove of excitement with activities like the Blyde River Canyon cruise, offering breathtaking views and serene waters. Explore the awe-inspiring God s Window, revealing panoramic vistas of the lush landscapes. Dive into the thrill of adventure with other activities, including scenic hikes, cultural village tours, and hot air balloon rides to name a few. Experience the heart of South Africa s wilderness and create lasting memories with our diverse range of activities.

KUBU SAFARI LODGE
At Kubu Safari Lodge, we believe that your stay with us should be nothing short of extraordinary. That’s why we go above and beyond to create a truly immersive and unforgettable experience for our guests. From the moment you arrive, you’ll be surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the African bush, with its vast landscapes, untamed wildlife, and stunning sunsets.
Main areas
Pool
In-room Amenities
Housekeeping
Secure Parking
Big 5 Safaris
Accommodation
Our suites have been thoughtfully designed to ensure that you’re as comfortable and relaxed as possible during your stay. Each suite is decorated with stylish and elegant furnishings, perfectly blending in with the natural beauty of the surroundings. We aim to provide you with a sense of home away from home, with every detail carefully considered to ensure your utmost comfort.
Whether you’re staying in our standard rooms or our luxurious suites, you can rest assured that every aspect of your accommodation has been designed to enhance your experience. Our suites offer a range of modern amenities, including air conditioning and tea/coffee-making facilities, ensuring that you have everything you need to make your stay as enjoyable as possible.
Click Here to view all options
Poolside Bliss
Dive into serenity at the heart of Kubu Safari Lodge, where our inviting pool becomes a refreshing oasis amidst the untamed beauty of nature. Surrounded by lush landscapes and the captivating sounds of the wild, our pool provides the perfect escape from the African heat.
Whether you choose to bask in the sun on a comfortable lounger or take a leisurely swim, the pool area at Kubu Safari Lodge invites you to relax and rejuvenate.
Click here to view the gallery
BOMA EVENINGS
Nestled under the African sky, our Boma offers a unique dining experience surrounded by the flickering glow of a bonfire. Engage your senses as our talented chefs craft a feast of flavours, representing the rich culinary heritage of Africa.
This open-air setting provides an immersive and unforgettable dining adventure. Share stories, laughter, and delectable dishes with fellow guests, creating memories that linger long after the last bite. At Kubu Safari Lodge s Boma, every meal is a celebration of the essence and warmth of African hospitality.
Click here to view the gallery
Private Functions
Ready for an epic group adventure? Kick your Kubu Safari Lodge experience up a notch by securing an exclusive dining extravaganza on our deck. Imagine savouring a mouthwatering braai and a delightful array of sensational African cuisines,  immersing your group in an exhilarating taste of Africa. Elevate your experience with us, turning ordinary moments into unforgettable memories in the heart of the wild!

ACCOMMODATION AT SAFARI LODGE
YOUR HOME AWAY FROM HOME
Our suites have been thoughtfully designed to ensure that you’re as comfortable and relaxed as possible during your stay. Each suite is decorated with stylish and elegant furnishings, perfectly blending in with the natural beauty of the surroundings. Our aim is to provide you with a sense of home away from home, with every detail carefully considered to ensure your utmost comfort. Whether you’re staying in our standard rooms or our luxurious suites, you can rest assured that every aspect of your accommodation has been designed to enhance your experience. Our suites offer a range of modern amenities, including air conditioning and tea/coffee-making facilities, ensuring that you have everything you need to make your stay as enjoyable as possible.
Standard Suites
Indulge in a relaxing stay in one of our charming standard rooms. Each room is thoughtfully designed with your comfort in mind, featuring earthy tones and stylish decor that perfectly complements the natural surroundings. Enjoy a peaceful night’s sleep in comfortable twin beds. You’ll find all the modern amenities you could need, including air conditioning and tea/coffee-making facilities, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay.
Click here to view the gallery
Luxury Suites
Experience unparalleled comfort at Kubu Safari Lodge in our beautiful luxury suites. The spacious en-suite bathroom has a shower and double basins. Modern conveniences such as air conditioning and tea/coffee-making facilities are included to enhance your stay. While our focus is on providing a comfortable and enjoyable experience, we ensure that your time with us is memorable and hassle free.
Click here to view the gallery
Family Suites
Step into a world of comfort and convenience with our spacious family suites at Kubu Safari Lodge, specially designed to cater for families travelling together. With two large beds, our family suites provide ample space for a peaceful night’s sleep for everyone along with an en-suite bathroom. The suites feature elegant furnishings and decor that seamlessly blend with the natural surroundings, creating a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere. Our suites are fitted with modern amenities such as air conditioning and tea /coffee-making facilities, ensuring that your stay is as comfortable and hassle free as possible.
Click here to view the gallery
Deluxe Suites
Indulge in ultimate luxury and comfort during your stay at Kubu Safari Lodge in one of our exquisitely designed deluxe suites. Our suites are carefully crafted to provide an unparalleled level of comfort, featuring elegant decor and premium furnishings that seamlessly blend with the natural surroundings, creating a harmonious balance between sophistication and nature. Our spacious en-suite bathroom offers a rejuvenating sanctuary ideal for unwinding after a thrilling day in the bush. We offer modern amenities such as air conditioning and tea/coffee-making facilities, ensuring that you have everything you need for a seamless and indulgent stay.

KUBU BUSH LODGE
Nestled adjacent to the lively Kubu Safari Lodge, Kubu Bush Lodge invites you into an intimate sanctuary for those craving tranquility. This cozy retreat boasts a mesmerizing waterhole, creating an exhilarating backdrop as it attracts a diverse array of wildlife, infusing an exciting element into your stay.
The lodge is thoughtfully designed, featuring 4 Bush Suites, 2 Luxury Bush Suites, and 1 Family Bush Suite. Complete with a rejuvenating pool, a lively boma area, and an indoor-outdoor relaxation common space with a bar, Kubu Bush Lodge offers the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation for an unforgettable experience.

Our suites have been thoughtfully crafted with your comfort in mind, ensuring a truly relaxing experience throughout your stay. Each suite is adorned with stylish and elegant furnishings, meticulously chosen to seamlessly blend with the natural beauty of the surroundings. Our primary objective is to provide you with a relaxing stay, where every detail is carefully considered to ensure your utmost well-being and satisfaction.
